description: This file contains functions for upgrading and checking images on a Linux-based embedded system, including partition management, EFI system updating, and image verification.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity and layout of the image to be written.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration data from backup to the device partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_efi_system_partition
methods.description: Updates EFI system partition by extracting EFI files from the image and copying them.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the overall upgrade process, including partition management and image writing.
